title: Six images of Keeping Quiet
back: Twelve, whales, hurt hands, clean clothes, the Earth in winter, no engines.

title: The argument, step by step
back: Count to twelve → exotic moment → harm stops → wars stop → not death but life → Earth's lesson.

title: Count to twelve and keep still
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="No language, no moving arms — a complete cycle" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><g opacity="0.9"><circle cx="160" cy="95" r="64" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="4"/><path d="M160.0,39.0 L160.0,33.0 M188.0,46.5 L191.0,41.3 M208.5,67.0 L213.7,64.0 M216.0,95.0 L222.0,95.0 M208.5,123.0 L213.7,126.0 M188.0,143.5 L191.0,148.7 M160.0,151.0 L160.0,157.0 M132.0,143.5 L129.0,148.7 M111.5,123.0 L106.3,126.0 M104.0,95.0 L98.0,95.0 M111.5,67.0 L106.3,64.0 M132.0,46.5 L129.0,41.3 " fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="M160,95 L160.0,63.0" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="M160,95 L160.0,47.0" fill="none" stroke="#E0B400" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><circle cx="160" cy="95" r="4" fill="#E0B400" stroke="none"/></g><text x="50" y="100" text-anchor="middle" font-size="20" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.4" stroke="none">…</text><text x="270" y="100" text-anchor="middle" font-size="20" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.4" stroke="none">…</text><text x="160.0" y="192" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">No language, no moving arms — a complete cycle</text></svg>
back: Twelve = the clock, the year. Languages divide; our restless arms do the damage. For twelve seconds, both stop.

back: Ceaseless activity hurts the sea; only when we stop do we notice. Pair this with the salt-gatherer who looks at his hurt hands — harm to the self.

title: The salt-gatherer's hurt hands
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="The exploited worker finally looks at himself" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><g transform="translate(130,100) scale(1.4)"><path d="M-30,40 Q-34,10 -20,-20 L-12,-20 L-14,10 L-8,-34 L0,-34 L-2,8 L4,-40 L12,-40 L8,10 L16,-26 L24,-26 L18,22 Q14,44 0,48 Q-26,50 -30,40 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.9" stroke="none"/></g><circle cx="146" cy="80" r="5" fill="#E0B400" stroke="none"/><circle cx="120" cy="110" r="4" fill="#E0B400" stroke="none"/><circle cx="160" cy="125" r="5" fill="#E0B400" stroke="none"/><text x="160.0" y="192" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">The exploited worker finally looks at himself</text></svg>
back: The man who gathers salt has never had a moment to see his own wounds. The stillness brings awareness.

title: Clean clothes, brothers in the shade
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="Those who prepare green wars put the weapons down" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><g><rect x="244.8" y="105.0" width="10.4" height="65.0" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.5" stroke="none"/><circle cx="250" cy="79.0" r="39.0" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.5" stroke="none"/><circle cx="226.6" cy="98.5" r="26.0" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.5" stroke="none"/><circle cx="273.4" cy="98.5" r="26.0" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.5" stroke="none"/></g><g><circle cx="90" cy="91.0" r="11.0" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.9" stroke="none"/><path d="M75.0,110.0 Q90,102.0 105.0,110.0 L102.6,138.0 L96.0,138.0 L97.2,180 H91.5 L90.6,140.0 H89.4 L88.5,180 H82.8 L84.0,138.0 L77.4,138.0 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.9" stroke="none"/></g><g><circle cx="150" cy="91.0" r="11.0" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.9" stroke="none"/><path d="M135.0,110.0 Q150,102.0 165.0,110.0 L162.6,138.0 L156.0,138.0 L157.2,180 H151.5 L150.6,140.0 H149.4 L148.5,180 H142.8 L144.0,138.0 L137.4,138.0 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.9" stroke="none"/></g><rect x="60" y="40" width="90" height="24" fill="#E0B400" fill-opacity="0.3" stroke="none"/><text x="105" y="56" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">no survivors</text><text x="160.0" y="192" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">Those who prepare green wars put the weapons down</text></svg>
back: Wars against nature, gas, fire; a victory in which everyone dies. In the pause the warriors are clean of blood and rest with their brothers.

title: The Earth's lesson
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="Stillness is renewal, not death" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><rect x="0" y="120" width="320" height="80" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.15" stroke="none"/><path d="M90,30 L115.2,70.5 L100.8,70.5 L122.4,102.0 L94.5,102.0 V120 H85.5 V102.0 L57.6,102.0 L79.2,70.5 L64.8,70.5 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.3" stroke="none"/><path d="M230,10 L260.8,59.49999999999999 L243.2,59.49999999999999 L269.6,98.0 L235.5,98.0 V120 H224.5 V98.0 L190.4,98.0 L216.8,59.49999999999999 L199.2,59.49999999999999 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.35" stroke="none"/><circle cx="160" cy="150" r="30" fill="#E0B400" stroke="none"/><text x="160" y="60" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="700" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">dead in winter · alive in spring</text><text x="160.0" y="192" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">Stillness is renewal, not death</text></svg>
back: Neruda wants no truck with death; life is what it is about. The apparent death of winter hides life getting ready — so can a human pause.

title: What we never do
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="Line to remember" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><g><rect x="28" y="36" width="264" height="72" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.08" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" rx="10"/><path d="M50,108 L42,122 L64,108 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.9" stroke="none"/><text x="160.0" y="77.25" text-anchor="middle" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">we never understand ourselves</text></g><text x="160" y="146" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.8" stroke="none">— so busy keeping life moving</text><text x="160.0" y="192" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">Line to remember</text></svg>
back: The sadness the poem wants to interrupt: single-minded motion that ends in threatening ourselves with death. Introspection is the cure.
